fact_previews: Zensmith is organized in three layers: Project Space, Task's Space, and Visual Management.
The 1st layer, Project Space, is a P2P network where the project manager creates a project and invites team members and followers.
The 2nd layer, Task's Space, supports task structuring, assignments, and dependencies management.
The 3rd layer, Visual Management, allows users to have a macro and micro vision of their activities.
The research for Zensmith started by dissecting various project and time management methodologies, including PMBOK, Prince2, V-Modell XT, Lean & Agile, and Theory of Constraints.
